text:
Maria: taking over the night swing, I'm primary for the next ~8h. Devon is secondary. Quick checklist so the handoff is clean: confirm PagerDuty schedule, AWS assume-role, Grafana access, runbook links. I'll monitor pages but ping me if anything noisy.

Devon: ack. reachable on phone + slack. If you get multiple pages in <10m i'll join the bridge.

Maria: posting the quick checks i run on handoff (paste these into your notes):
```
# PagerDuty: verify you're on-call
pd schedules list --query "name=='prod-primary'" || pd schedule show prod-primary
# AWS: assume oncall role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOnCall --role-session-name MariaSwing
# Grafana: confirm dashboards load (alerts on)
https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/production-overview
# Runbooks
https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency
https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pager-prioritization
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT #478 triggered: embeddings-service latency spike (>300ms P95) — PagerDuty notification sent to prod-primary.

Sara: Maria — i've added you to the Grafana org (Viewer + Alerting) and put you in the PD escalation policy for the night. You should have access now.

Maria: trying assume-role now...
`aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOnCall --role-session-name MariaSwing`
Assume-role succeeded, temporary creds available. Grafana loads, dashboard widgets ok. PD shows me as current primary. :thumbsup:

ops-bridge: Bridge opened by Maria for incident 478 — https://meet.redwood/bridges/478 (auto-archived after close)

Devon: i'll take infra-facing pages (hosts, k8s, networking). If this looks like model-quality regressions, i'll re-route to ML oncall @Leo.

Maria: runbook quick actions if latency is due to worker exhaustion:
```
# scale down/up embedding workers to clear stuck tasks
kubectl -n prod scale deployment embeddings-workers --replicas=0
sleep 12
kubectl -n prod scale deployment embeddings-workers --replicas=10
# tail logs for first 2 minutes after restart
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embeddings-workers --tail=200 -f
```
Also check prefix cache sizes and KV cache hit rate (grafana panels). If cache miss rate > 30% consider warming via batch-replay (runbook link above).

Maria: logging handoff note in PD with the above checklist and initial findings. If you pick up a page, add a short note in the incident timeline so we have context for followups.

Sara: added escalation rule for model-quality to include @Leo and a 2-min notify if p95 > 250ms.

Leo: oncall standby — will jump on model-quality if labeled.

Maria: thanks all. primary->me confirmed, secondary->Devon. Grafana/AWS/PD checked. Leaving the bridge open until we see stable P95 for 15m. If anything changes i'll post an update here.

Devon: copy. i'll watch infra metrics and post any node-level anomalies.

incident-bot: NOTE: remember to run post-incident checklist when closed: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/checklist

Maria: acknowledged, will run post-incident checklist and tag the incident for a short blameless postmortem if it's >30m impact.
